name: tx-root-check-removed
find: if (orderedTrieRoot(txs, kc) !== lc(block.transactionsRoot)) throw new Error('the transactions do not reproduce transactionsRoot');

name: receipts-root-unverified
find: const verified = verifyBlockReceipts({ header: block, expectedBlockHash: want, receipts, txHashes, chain: BASE_MAINNET }, { keccak: kc, headerHash: (h, k) => headerHash(h, k) });
replace: const verified = { logs: receipts.flatMap((x) => x.logs.map((l) => ({ ...l, transactionIndex: Number(BigInt(l.transactionIndex)) }))), receiptsRoot: block.receiptsRoot };

name: consumed-offchain-hint-accepted-as-none
find: if (consumed) contradiction(`in block ${m} ${hint.blockHash}, which is not the finalized chain's block ${m} (${want})`);

name: nonce-consumed-reported-as-success
find: result: rc ? { state: 'receipt', receipt: rc } : { state: 'nonce-consumed' }
replace: result: rc ? { state: 'receipt', receipt: rc } : { state: 'receipt', receipt: { status: 'success' } }

name: pending-costs-not-committed
find: const committed = pl.remaining.reduce((a, e) => a + maxCost(e), 0n);

name: lost-bytes-not-rebroadcast
find: for (const e of lost) await broadcast(e.raw, e.hash);
